* '''Playtest''' ([[Death Star: Central Core (Virtual Set 15) (Playtest)]]): Card image published 22 June 2021<ref name="img-Playtest">Players Committee card image as published: <code>Virtual15-Light/large/death_star_central_core.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/7df3091df9d13149ec8100ab0d8c2b838567a2a7/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/large/death_star_central_core.gif holotable commit 7df3091], 22 June 2021); <code>Virtual15-Light/hires/death_star_central_core.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ee4c4cd8bccdd1870eb7593e38093132a51fe2c4/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/death_star_central_core.png holotable commit ee4c4cd], 22 June 2021); <code>Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarcentralcore.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/30816d1eceffdd0a07a5af277fcbcbc9fc96f665/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarcentralcore.png holotable commit 30816d1], 22 June 2021); <code>Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarcentralcore.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/30816d1eceffdd0a07a5af277fcbcbc9fc96f665/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarcentralcore.gif holotable commit 30816d1], 22 June 2021) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: If A Power Loss 'shut down' this game, Force drain +1 here and Death Star Tractor Beam lost. Dark: If you occupy, opponent must first use 1 Force to move a character from here.” Playtest image: uploaded on 22 June 2021, the evening before the set's official release (23 June 2021), and replaced on release day. The card is stored upright (portrait: PNG 703×980; GIF 745×1039, holotable 7df3091); the same day the files were renamed (holotable 30816d1, “filename fixes”, same image). Words as on the released card.
* '''Original''' (this page): Card image published 23 June 2021<ref name="img-Original">Players Committee card image as published: <code>Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarcentralcore.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9319460b36d9e7accecf0d32799fc84256802ef7/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarcentralcore.gif holotable commit 9319460], 23 June 2021); <code>Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarcentralcore.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9319460b36d9e7accecf0d32799fc84256802ef7/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarcentralcore.png holotable commit 9319460], 23 June 2021) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: If A Power Loss 'shut down' this game, Force drain +1 here and Death Star Tractor Beam lost. Dark: If you occupy, opponent must first use 1 Force to move a character from here.” '''What changed:''' Virtual Set 15 release (23 June 2021): the PC re-uploaded the card turned 90° to landscape, the way location cards are shown (holotable 9319460, “fixing rotation on v15”: PNG 980×703, GIF 745×534). Same image, words and layout as the playtest upload apart from the orientation. Every published image that differs from the one before is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Death Star: Central Core (Virtual Set 15) (Errata)]]): Card image published 21 April 2022<ref name="img-PC-E1">Players Committee card image as published: <code>Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarcentralcore.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3f7288d580f892a638c6e3b78ca43474ade7756a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarcentralcore.gif holotable commit 3f7288d], 21 April 2022); <code>Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarcentralcore.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2640d508acff17553640735ee7a15ad93fa78a65/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarcentralcore.png holotable commit 2640d50], 20 April 2022) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: If A Power Loss 'shut down' this game, Force drain +1 here and Death Star Tractor Beam lost. Dark: If you occupy, opponent must first use 1 Force to move a character from here.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' The PC re-rendered the card from a new high-resolution master (holotable 2640d50, “Set 18 and errata”, 20 April 2022: PNG now 1039×745; the GIF copy, holotable 3f7288d, 21 April 2022, stays 745×534), so art, frame, icons and text all render slightly differently. Most visibly: the line down the right border “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” became “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.” in small capitals. Words unchanged.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Death Star: Central Core (Virtual Set 15) (Errata 2)]]): Card image published 11 June 2022<ref name="img-PC-E2">Players Committee card image as published: <code>Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarcentralcore.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarcentralcore.gif holotable commit 6894629], 11 June 2022) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: If A Power Loss 'shut down' this game, Force drain +1 here and Death Star Tractor Beam lost. Dark: If you occupy, opponent must first use 1 Force to move a character from here.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' The PC re-made the GIF copy (the file the PC card data uses) at a larger size, 745×534 → 1039×745 pixels, with its new GIF maker (holotable commit 6894629, “updated gif maker so that the landscape images are resized appropriately”, 11 June 2022, which re-made the landscape GIFs of Virtual Sets 4 and 14–18 and 11 alternate-image cards; the new file is PNG data kept under the <code>.gif</code> name). It is the same card enlarged — words, art, layout and errata mark are unchanged; the new GIF is pixel-for-pixel the high-resolution PNG copy the PC had published on 20 April 2022 (<code>Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarcentralcore.png</code>), which until then appeared only in the <code>hires</code> folder. A visible (resolution) change of the card image, so a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: re-renders and resolution changes are versions).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Death Star: Central Core (Virtual Set 15) (Errata 3)]]): Card image published 9 March 2026 (current; the image the PC card data uses)<ref name="img-PC-E3">Players Committee card image as published: <code>Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarcentralcore.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6f23e077ed3f1bb8f34b62099641028868d7a2ae/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/large/deathstarcentralcore.gif holotable commit 6f23e07], 9 March 2026); <code>Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarcentralcore.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e02f932ae2c407c7c4f2e22fe565a8a64afd742b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstarcentralcore.png holotable commit e02f932], 7 March 2026) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: While opponent occupies, you may not play Blast The Door, Kid! during battles on Death Star. Dark: While Obi-Wan here, total ability of 6 or more required for you to draw battle destiny here.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints “E1” but is errata 3 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' Light Side text “If A Power Loss 'shut down' this game, Force drain +1 here and Death Star Tractor Beam lost.” became “While opponent occupies, you may not play Blast The Door, Kid! during battles on Death Star.” Dark Side text “If you occupy, opponent must first use 1 Force to move a character from here.” became “While Obi-Wan here, total ability of 6 or more required for you to draw battle destiny here.” The image now prints the errata mark “E1” (holotable e02f932, “LS Errata”, PNG, 7 March 2026; GIF 6f23e07, 9 March 2026).
